title: Beat visualizer loop (9:16)
description: A 16-second vertical music-visualizer loop for a show, mix, channel or label ident: rings, a mirrored equaliser or snapping kinetic shapes hit exactly on the kick of a procedural four-on-the-floor bed, with a kicker, the title, a credit line and a beat counter. Picture and music are locked to the same tempo (120 BPM, 8 bars; every beat falls on a whole frame at 30 fps). Synced by tempo, not by analysing audio. Code-rendered (scene.beat-visualizer + audio.pulse).

title.description: The show, mix, channel, label or event name exactly as written in the brief, at most 32 characters

credit.description: Optional line under the title copied exactly from the brief: host, artist, or schedule (e.g. 'hosted by Mara Ellis'), at most 44 characters; empty if the brief gives none

kicker.description: Two or three word label above the title naming the format (e.g. Weekly mix, Live set, New episode); no dates, numbers or claims the brief does not make

look.description: Visual look: signal (night navy, coral rings), club (black, lime and cyan equaliser), studio (light, kinetic square), lagoon (deep teal, mint rings)

energy.description: Music energy: product (steady), night (dark, minor), upbeat (claps and busy hats); all locked to 120 BPM

scene.description: The visualizer animation, locked to 120 BPM with the first downbeat at 0 s

music.description: Music bed at 120 BPM with its first kick at 0 s; produced procedurally. A supplied track must be cleared, exactly 120 BPM and start on a downbeat, or the picture will not be in sync

copy_examples.brief: Visualizer loop for Low Tide Radio, our Sunday ambient-house show hosted by Mara Ellis. Late-night feel.
copy_examples.note: Title and credit are copied exactly from the brief. The kicker names the format in two words without inventing a time, date or episode number.

style.typography: Inter ExtraBold title, tracked capitals kicker, medium credit

direction.action: Hits on every kick (frames 0, 15, 30...), accented downbeats every 60 frames; kicker on beat 1, title on beat 2, credit on beat 3; copy leaves in the last bar (frame 420)

notes: Sync is by tempo: the scene and the bed are both locked to 120 BPM, 4/4, first downbeat at 0 s (audio.pulse places its kick at k * 0.5 s from 0). At 30 fps every beat is a whole frame (15 frames), so each hit peaks on the kick's own frame. The music track starts at frame 0 with no fade-in so the first kick is heard.
The visuals do not analyse the audio. Replacing the music with another track keeps sync only if it is exactly 120 BPM and its first downbeat is at 0 s.
Title and credit are VERBATIM. The procedural bed is not anyone's song: the title must name a show, mix, channel or event, not present the bed as a named artist's release.
Full-frame brightness changes stay at one soft glow per beat (2 Hz); faster accents move only small elements.

quality_gates.description: Integrated loudness lands within 1 LU of the -14 LUFS delivery target.
Decoded true peak stays at or below -0.5 dBTP after AAC encoding.
No stretch of blank picture (no visible contrast, any colour) lasts longer than 0.5 seconds.
The bed plays throughout: no silence (below -50 dB) longer than 0.5 seconds.
A reviewer watches with sound and confirms the hits land on the kick (no analyzer measures audio-visual sync).
The owner confirms the title and credit are approved and the video does not present the procedural bed as a named artist's track.
